newsitem.title: USA: Maine environmentalists see drop in enforcement.
newsitem.headline: Maine environmentalists see drop in enforcement.

text.p: Maine environmental groups said a review of Department of Environmental Protection records indicated fewer fines and enforcement actions were being taken against polluters.
In 1995, there were just 50 complaints, down sharply from 1991, when the Department of Environmental Protection brought more than 200 cases against companies violating clean air and land laws.
The state agency said it would rather help companies follow the law than hit them with fines, but environmental groups argued the agency is not enforcing the law.
